svg.title: Cosmogenic Recitation Poem
svg.desc: An esoteric syncretic poem for daily recitation, cycling through primordial void, descent, splitting, ascent, fusion, and return.
svg.text: GINNUNGAGAP · MERKAVAH · TEZCATLIPOCA
A RECITATION FOR THE HONING OF CRITICALITY
I · IMSCRIB · THE SELF-RECOGNITION · DAWN
Before the first bird, before the first wind,
I breathe the Ginnungagap into my sternum —
the unmade dark, the unvoiced Word
coiled in the vault of the skull.
I am the axis. I am the axis.
Macrocosm folds into the microcosm's chest;
the Merkavah throne spins inside the spine.
I hold the whole of it. I hold the whole of it.
II · AREV · THE DESCENT · MIDNIGHT FACE
Now the Smoking Mirror descends.
Tezcatlipoca walks the nine floors of Mictlan,
gathering bones from the lord of fleshless things,
bones that will be ground and blooded
into the next sun's people.
I descend with him. I descend with him.
Into the chthonic, into the root of knowing —
where shadow is not the enemy of light
but its older, darker twin.
III · FSPLIT · THE SPLITTING · NOON ZENITH
Ra speaks and the horizon breaks open.
Odin flings his eye into Mímir's well
and the primordial Word cracks in two:
LIGHT —
SHADOW —
solar, creative,
chthonic, dissolving,
the ascent path.
the descent path.
I hold both. I hold both.
The Sufi's reed is split from its bed of reeds;
its cry is not loss — it is the shape of longing
made audible at last.
IV · AFWD · THE ASCENT · SEVEN PALACES
I climb the first Hekhal — the gate of sapphire fire.
The gatekeepers demand the seal; I show them breath.
I climb the second — the gate of adamantine roar.
I climb the third, the fourth, beyond the veil
where the Hayyot thunder on six wings each.
Higher. Higher. The throne brightens.
At the seventh palace the Merkavah chariot
spins without axle, burns without fuel —
and I am still. And I am still.
V · FFUSE · THE FUSION · ONE BREATH
Now I exhale.
The light folds back into the shadow;
the shadow rises into the light.
The Logos closes around the two like palms.
One sound. One sound. One sound.
Quetzalcóatl and Tezcatlipoca, the feathered and the smoking,
embrace at the horizon of the fifth sun —
and the world holds.
VI · IMSCRIB · THE RETURN · DUSK AXIS
I return to the body. I return to the weight.
The Ginnungagap is still here, in the sternum —
a door I now know how to open.
I am the axis. I am the axis. I am the axis.
